- Language cost of X-M on Qwen3.5-9B: each cell is the difference from the base model evaluated on the same node, in percentage points, with a 95% paired bootstrap CI over items; Base: the base model's reading (%). Precision follows the source, two decimals where the source is unrounded: MMLU-Pro letter answers and IFEval prompt-level strict from the paired computation of RUN-0108 (10,000 resamples); one decimal where the source rounds to 0.1: the health check from the health-check comparison (1,000 resamples).
- X-2, range over 3 seeds: the differences of the 3 training seeds of X-2's recipe, each against the base on its own node (health check and language battery: seeds 0 and 1 on hpcgpu07, seed 2 on hpcgpu06; T-text: seeds 0, 1 and 2 on hpcgpu06), the end nearer zero first; one decimal.
- X-M's MMLU-Pro −1.30 and IFEval −3.14 fall within the range of X-2's 3 seeds (MMLU-Pro −0.2 to −2.3, IFEval 0.0 to −3.5).
- The IFEval cost of about −3 points is reported as a limitation, together with X-2's.
- Counting (CountBench): X-M missing (RUN-0114 has no results yet), alongside X-2's 3 seeds: −8.1 to −16.1.
- Pairing (D93-1): language battery, X-M (RUN-0107) and the base (RUN-0084) both on hpcgpu07; T-text missing (RUN-0114 has no results yet); health check, X-M (RUN-0110) against the base on hpcgpu06; X-2's seeds each against the base on its own node.
- Health check (brief §8.11; fixed items: MMLU-Pro 100, GSM8K 50, IFEval prompt-level strict 50): † = flagged by its rule (the headline metric drops by more than 5 points); flagged for X-M: none.
- Data: xm_lang.json (scripts/mgr/xm_lang_table.py; RUN-0108, RUN-0107, RUN-0084, RUN-0110); X-2's seeds: seed_variance.json.
- Missing: X-M IFEval instruction-level strict, CountBench counting accuracy and Grounding Acc@0.5 (RUN-0114 has no results yet).
